deployment: reference shape: Microsoft 365 Business Premium tenant (Defender for Business, Defender for Office 365 Plan 1, Entra ID P1) reached through the defender-xdr MCP server; no advanced hunting, polling only. A capability probe run against the tenant supersedes this file.

asset.cmdb.notes: device role, OS, exposure and tags (defender_get_software for the software inventory); business criticality comes from the SOC Knowledge Base

identity.directory.notes: logon relationships only; role and privilege need a directory tool bound here

cases.store.notes: closed incidents and their entities; the 90-day retrospective sweep runs here, never through telemetry

malware.repository.notes: prevalence and first-seen by hash; hashes only leave the environment

telemetry.endpoint.notes: alert evidence only: there is no query language to translate playbook questions into; every unanswered question is a visibility gap

ticketing.notes: tuning tickets as incident comments until a ticketing tool is bound
